summary.text: Jason Thompson is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 3 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as businessman.

paragraphs.text: Jason Thompson earned a bachelor's degree in 2006 and a graduate degree in 2010, both from Brigham Young University, according to Ballotpedia.
He succeeded Dan Johnson as the representative for District 3.
